text: Mizuno Corporation's annual business report states, under 'Relationship with the parent company', that there is no applicable item — the company has no parent company.
short: Mizuno Corporation has no parent company (business report: no parent-company relationship).

source.name: Mizuno Corporation - Notice of the 113th Ordinary General Meeting of Shareholders (business report, parent-company section)
source.quote: （1）親会社との関係 該当事項はありません。
